info.title: Apache APISIX Admin API
info.description:
The Apache APISIX Admin API is a REST interface for managing gateway resources and applying configuration changes without restarting APISIX. Accepted changes propagate to workers asynchronously.

This contract targets Apache APISIX 3.16.0. Resource operations are available with the etcd configuration provider; /configs operations require the YAML provider and replace those resource routes. The default response format is Admin API v3 (deployment.admin.admin_api_version: v3). The legacy v2 format is also described. List filtering and pagination apply only to v3.

Authentication uses a configured Admin API key in X-API-KEY; api_key query and x_api_key cookie are also accepted. Authentication can be disabled in deployment.admin.admin_key_required. The HEAD /apisix/admin probe and POST /schema/validate/{resource} handler do not check the key in this release. Network allowlists and deployment configuration still apply.

Schemas describe built-in validation. Additional Lua checks validate references, enabled plugins and their plugin-specific schemas, certificates, expressions, upstreams, and protocol configuration. These checks depend on deployment state and are not expressible completely in OpenAPI. Plugin and metadata configurations remain open objects; query the schema endpoints and consult the plugin reference for the installed plugin. Changes propagate asynchronously to workers.

See [APISIX Documentation](https://apisix.apache.org/docs/apisix/3.16/getting-started/README/) for more information.

servers.description: Admin API listener. HTTPS requires `deployment.admin.https_admin: true` and certificate and key paths under `deployment.admin.admin_api_mtls`.

protocol.description: Protocol scheme. Use `https` only when HTTPS is enabled and the Admin API certificate and key are configured.

host.description: Host used by the client. The default listener binds to all interfaces, while the default allowlist permits `127.0.0.0/24`.

StandaloneConfig.description: YAML-provider configuration. Credentials are entries in consumers with id username/credentials/id. Resource version numbers may not decrease; unchanged versions retain existing resources. Omitted versions increment by one, and omitted resource arrays are cleared on update. Lua validates duplicate IDs and resource checkers, without cross-resource reference checks.

Page.name: page
Page.description: v3 only. Pagination requires both page and page_size to be numeric. A page below 1 is clamped to 1. Omission does not supply a default.

PageSize.name: page_size
PageSize.description: v3 only. With a numeric page, paginate after filtering and sort by createdIndex. If either argument is absent, return all filtered entries.
